modules.name: Wastewater lift stations and coastal water level

datum.basis: NOAA CO-OPS station 8726520 datums: NAVD88 4.85 ft and MLLW 3.37 ft station datum (epoch 1983-2001), so a water level in ft MLLW minus 1.48 is the plane in ft NAVD88. The Coastal Water Resilience console uses the same offset.

modules.zoneLabel: Pinellas County evacuation zone at the station (Know Your Zone layer)
modules.screenNote: A station counts as screened when its ground elevation (USGS 3DEP terrain, ft NAVD88) is at or below the water plane. This compares terrain with a water level; it is not equipment flooding or operating status.
modules.flowNote: FDEP reported annual treatment throughput for the three City water reclamation facilities, shown as dated reference text only. It is not a spill, an outage or a flow at any station.

surge.text: Pinellas County publishes evacuation zones A to E; storm surge evacuation orders are given by zone.
surge.date: Zone layer edition May 29, 2026, as captured by the Coastal Water Resilience console

tropical.text: St. Petersburg sits on a peninsula between Tampa Bay and the Gulf; evacuation follows the Pinellas County zones.
